create_noise_augment_transform: create a NoiseAugmentTransform to mix random noise samples into audio waveforms at a configurable SNR level
create_music_augment_transform: create a MusicAugmentTransform subclass to augment audio data with music noise samples from a directory
create_background_noise_augment: create a BackgroundNoiseAugmentTransform to augment audio with background noise samples from WAV files
create_babble_augment_transform: create a BabbleAugmentTransform to mix multiple speech samples together as overlapping babble noise
create_sporadic_noise_augment: create a SporadicNoiseAugmentTransform to inject short sporadic noise bursts at random positions in audio
